items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I went on, I played with Rainier from that time.

ctx.x: And when I looked at that list he had, he had every night up to Mardi Gras. And I had just, it was about 12 or 13 dates on that list he gave. I went on, I played with Rainier from that time. It was about 19, 1923, I think. It was 23.
Did you keep your day job or give it up then later when you started working so much?
